title: Accept {role:, content:} messages in Google Gemini and Vertex AI #chat

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 - [SECURITY]: A change which fixes a security vulnerability.
 
 ## [Unreleased]
+- [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1076] Accept `{role:, content:}` messages in `Langchain::LLM::GoogleGemini#chat` and `Langchain::LLM::GoogleVertexAI#chat`, converting them to `parts` with system messages as the system instruction; `OutputFixingParser`, `Vectorsearch#ask`, `Chunker::Semantic`, the Ragas evals and HyDE got a 400 from Google before.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1077] Send `temperature`, `seed`, `top_p`, `max_tokens` (as `num_predict`) and the other sampling parameters of `Langchain::LLM::Ollama#chat` in `options`, where Ollama reads them; at the top level they were ignored, including the default `temperature: 0.0`.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1073] Raise `Langchain::LLM::Anthropic`'s default `max_tokens` from 256 to 16,000; Claude Sonnet 5 and later, Haiku 5.5 and Opus 5 and later think by default within that cap, so they often stopped before writing any text and `#chat_completion` returned `nil`.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1072] Ask the LLM with `#chat` in `Langchain::Chunker::Semantic`, the Ragas evals and `Vectorsearch::Base#similarity_search_with_hyde`; they called `#complete`, which Google Gemini, Vertex AI and Mistral AI don't implement, and the semantic chunker passed `max_tokens_to_sample:`, which `Langchain::LLM::Anthropic#complete` rejected.

@@ -0,0 +1,42 @@
+# frozen_string_literal: true
+
+module Langchain::LLM
+  # Lets Google Gemini and Vertex AI take messages in the `{role:, content:}` shape the rest of the
+  # library sends (`Vectorsearch#ask`, `OutputFixingParser`, the Ragas evals...). The API only accepts
+  # `{role:, parts: [...]}`, with "model" for the assistant and the system prompt outside `contents`.
+  module GoogleMessageFormat
+    private
+
+    # @param params [Hash] The #chat params
+    # @return [Hash] The params with text messages converted, and system messages moved to :system
+    def to_google_messages(params)
+      messages = Array(params[:messages])
+      system_texts, messages = messages.partition { |message| role_of(message) == "system" && text_content?(message) }
+      system_texts = system_texts.map { |message| content_of(message) }
+      system_texts.unshift(params[:system]) if params[:system]
+
+      params.merge(
+        messages: messages.map { |message| text_content?(message) ? text_message(message) : message },
+        system: system_texts.any? ? system_texts.join("\n\n") : nil
+      ).compact
+    end
+
+    def text_message(message)
+      role = (role_of(message) == "assistant") ? "model" : role_of(message)
+      {role: role, parts: [{text: content_of(message)}]}
+    end
+
+    # Only a String content is converted: messages already in Google's shape have :parts instead
+    def text_content?(message)
+      message.is_a?(Hash) && content_of(message).is_a?(String) && !(message.key?(:parts) || message.key?("parts"))
+    end
+
+    def role_of(message)
+      (message[:role] || message["role"]).to_s
+    end
+
+    def content_of(message)
+      message.key?(:content) ? message[:content] : message["content"]
+    end
+  end
+end

+    context "with messages in the {role:, content:} shape" do
+      let(:sent) { [] }
+
+      before do
+        allow_any_instance_of(Net::HTTP::Post).to receive(:body=) { |_request, body| sent << JSON.parse(body) }
+      end
+
+      it "sends them as parts, with the assistant as model and system messages as the system instruction" do
+        subject.chat(messages: [
+          {role: "system", content: "Be brief."},
+          {role: "user", content: "How high is the sky?"},
+          {"role" => "assistant", "content" => "Very high."},
+          {role: "user", content: "How high exactly?"}
+        ])
+
+        expect(sent.first["contents"]).to eq([
+          {"role" => "user", "parts" => [{"text" => "How high is the sky?"}]},
+          {"role" => "model", "parts" => [{"text" => "Very high."}]},
+          {"role" => "user", "parts" => [{"text" => "How high exactly?"}]}
+        ])
+        expect(sent.first["system_instruction"]).to eq({"parts" => [{"text" => "Be brief."}]})
+      end
+
+      it "joins a system message to the system: param" do
+        subject.chat(system: "You are a bot.", messages: [{role: "system", content: "Be brief."}, {role: "user", content: "Hi"}])
+
+        expect(sent.first["system_instruction"]).to eq({"parts" => [{"text" => "You are a bot.\n\nBe brief."}]})
+      end
+    end
+
